hint: Changes apply live. In text mode the font restarts the window.

accent.description: The primary colour follows the wallpaper; the rest are ANSI colours from the theme.
accent.label: Active line colour

active_scale.description: Size multiplier of the line being sung (image mode only).
active_scale.label: Active line size

anchor.description: Where the window opens: center, top-left, bottom-right...
anchor.label: Window position

animation_ms.description: Duration of the scroll between lines, in milliseconds. 0 = instant.
animation_ms.label: Transition

custom_color.description: Hex colour (#rrggbb) used when the accent is "custom".
custom_color.label: Custom colour

direction.description: Down: the lyrics come from the top. Up: the lyrics come from the bottom.
direction.label: Scroll direction

font_family.description: Font used for the lyrics. Image mode accepts any font; text mode only accepts monospaced ones.
font_family.label: Font family

font_size.description: Size of the lyrics in pixels.
font_size.label: Font size

footer.description: Show the elapsed time and the progress bar.
footer.label: Time bar

ghost.description: Dim the block slightly while it moves for a softer feel.
ghost.label: Soft transitions

header.description: Show the title, the artist and the status tags.
header.label: Header

height.description: Height of the terminal window in pixels.
height.label: Window height

hints.description: Show the keyboard shortcuts at the bottom.
hints.label: Keyboard hints

karaoke.description: Light up the active line character by character as the song plays.
karaoke.label: Karaoke glow

marker.description: Show a marker next to the line being sung.
marker.label: Active line marker

offset_ms.description: Shift the lyrics in milliseconds to fine tune the sync.
offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset

render_mode.description: Text: drawn by the terminal. Image: drawn with Pillow, allows other line sizes and any font.
render_mode.label: Rendering mode

visible_above.description: How many lines are drawn above the active line.
visible_above.label: Visible lines above

visible_below.description: How many lines are drawn below the active line.
visible_below.label: Visible lines below

width.description: Width of the terminal window in pixels.
width.label: Window width

subtitle: Nothing is playing
title: Lyrics Carousel
